scopeNotes: New text needs independent review; earlier hashes do not certify it.
Map endpoints are not historical founding or extinction dates.

This record is the modern European state, whose imported border coverage begins in 1914. It is not Caucasian Albania, a medieval principality or every Albanian-speaking community. The 1912 independence declaration is separately sourced and does not verify the 1914 polygon.
Imported snapshots run through occupation and regime changes. No uninterrupted sovereignty is inferred from their continuity, and no territorial claims beyond the imported record are added.

Photography, music and textiles have histories predating the modern state. Undated traditions are not assigned invented founding dates or described as newly invented in 1912. Marubi studio practices are not assumed to represent all households.

Marubi’s 1970 transfer is described without assuming entirely voluntary donation under nationalization. Its museum’s separate archive account explicitly describes the wider nationalization setting. The card relies on the 2017 exhibition text for the named studio’s dates.

UNESCO descriptions were read through their complete indexed text when live pages returned a challenge. Inscription years date recognition, not origins. Regional clothing and music are not presented as uniform national practice.

The bank’s historical narrative and object catalog are distinct sources. Printed denominations, stamped portrait and watermark are identified by catalog descriptions. No unsupported explanation for the first note’s short circulation is supplied.

The USHMM photograph catalog documents a named family’s rescue. The card does not generalize this to all Albanians, all Jewish refugees, all occupied territories or an unsourced national survival total.

House of Leaves collection descriptions support concrete devices and a telephone list. Broad museum rhetoric about state omnipotence is not reproduced as a claim that every home was continuously bugged. No exact telephone total is generalized outside its time and place.

The OSCE constitutional translation incorporates the January 2007 amendment. Used provisions are cited as the historic constitutional framework; the card does not present this file as a fully updated statement of every current law, or treat legal promises as proof of implementation.

The State Department page contains an outdated forecast of NATO admission. That forecast is not reproduced. No current officeholder, population estimate or unsourced transition election result is added.
Independent historical review, border assessment and depth certification remain pending.
